messages:
mia_cs: Heads up — BeaconHealth flipped a KB ingestion pipeline into prod an hour ago. They're seeing a ~10x jump in embedding QPS. Asking for guidance on capacity and best short-term mitigations.

jordan_se: Do we have exact numbers (avg/peak) and which embedding model they're calling?

mia_cs: They reported: avg 480 QPS, peak ~2.1k QPS in a 5m window. Using `lh-embed-3k` (4096 dims). Client is doing near-real-time bulk ingest + retry logic.

alex_solutions: Quick suggestions: client-side batching + backoff, enable prefix caching if KB updates are small, and consider async ingestion to a queue. But for sustained 2k peaks we should discuss dedicated or reserved capacity.

sam_re: This reads as a clear expansion signal. If they keep this pattern we'll need to propose a committed capacity plan. I'll prep a cost delta estimate if someone can confirm their token/sec -> GPU utilization mapping.

jordan_se: I can run a quick perf sim on our side. If they're embedding dims ~4k we likely saturate A100-ish at ~3-4k QPS depending on batch size. Recommend testing 64-128 batch sizes.

mia_cs: I already asked Beacon for a steady-state qps profile and retention window. They said ingestion spikes are tied to nightly ETL + some streaming events — repeatable.

alex_solutions: If they can tolerate a 30s window for backfills we can recommend async batching to flatten the curve — reduces peak cost significantly. For tight latency, Dedicated + autoscale with burst will be cleaner.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Created ticket #CS-3421 for provisioning guidance (assigned: jordan_se).

sam_re: I'll own renewal/upsell outreach. Can you get a 14‑day histogram of QPS and an estimate of embedding units/day? I'll put together a pricing proposal and a short ROI slide.

mia_cs: Will get the histogram and ask Beacon for a sample ingest job. Scheduling a 30m sync Thursday 10am PT — invite sent. @jordan_se @sam_re @alex_solutions please join.

jordan_se: On it. Will bring perf sims and a couple config options (batch sizes, concurrency, fallback model variants). :eyes:

alex_solutions: I'll draft a quick runbook for CS to give Beacon (short-term mitigations + recommended next steps).

mia_cs: Thanks team — this looks like both a renewal risk (if we can't keep latency) and an expansion opportunity (committed capacity). I'll track outcomes in the ticket.
